evidence.snippet: can read and update issues, accounts, contacts, knowledge base articles, tasks and projects, triggers, and more
Returns a paginated list of accounts for the organization.

decisions.reason: Pages show multiple distinct resources (accounts, issues, contacts, knowledge base, tasks, triggers, call recordings, audit logs) with CRUD-style endpoints, indicating more than a narrow single-purpose API but no evidence of hundreds of endpoints to call it broad.

evidence.snippet: Does Pylon offer a free trial or free plan? Pylon offers free trials for prospects.

decisions.reason: The pricing page shows no free plan (only sales-arranged trials) and lists REST API as a feature only on the Advanced/Enterprise tiers, indicating a paid plan is required to get working API access.
